consumption: Create the one fixed sibling ref exactly once using the shared repository claim capability, before deriving requests. Bind original claim commit, exact source and executor identity. A failed or ambiguous consumption is never retried. Another directory, checkout, host, workflow or chat cannot initialize under the consumed claim.
published_authority: Runtime binding, separately recorded execution authorization, complete receiving-source qualification receipt and preinitialization journal each require repository-relative path, exact SHA-256 and immutable repository commit. Fetch and compare the exact published bytes. Claim and authorization both bind the current exact execution branch HEAD. Runtime pins must match the independently qualified source commit and current receiving checkout. Runtime also binds the separately published, exact independently reviewed prospective checkpoint clarification acceptance; it grants no execution authority.
initializer_seed_rule: 9250925200 + 2 * frozen row + starting player index. The same row and schedule use the same initializer seed for all four lists. Initial measured-deck orderings and later shuffle ranks remain the exact already-frozen corpus; no extra sampling or matchup seed generation is authorized.
execution_order: Existing compiler order: rows 1..64, PLAY then DRAW, immutable submitted v1 followed by the three frozen candidates; exactly allocations 1..512 with no replacement, resume or retry.
raw_evidence: Before initialization persist exact admitted input and declaration. Before every real action persist its indexed intent; after return persist indexed events, state digest and error. Persist typed status, complete event/checkpoint metrics, initial/final state, actions and replay result. Hash every raw file into the allocation artifact, hash the artifact into its append-only finalization record, and revalidate all bindings before the numerical rule. Preserve every eligible quiet observation with accepted-action index, exact state digest and typed checkpoint. The first-per-turn checkpoint file is a derived compatibility view only. Replay restores the recorded initial state without initialization, reconstructs the complete eligible-observation sequence while replaying each action, and checks indices, order, state digests and checkpoint values.
dormant_entrypoint: After all frozen gates, exact published authorization and create-only claim pass: python3 industrial-waste/v2/r1_execute.py prepare --root . --session <bound-session.json> --output build/official/industrial-waste-v2-r1-attempt-1; then IW_V2_R1_PREPARED_DIRECTORY=<absolute canonical output> just test-class IndustrialWasteV2R1OfficialExecutionTest. The canonical parent directory must exist before prepare. The full corpus stops on the first invalid, rejected, exception or integrity failure.
